Real errors: unit 40 invented sense 'obstruct' (avaghaṭṭayet). Minor: unbracketed copulas in verbless clauses (14,17,29,30), 3-member dvandva with 'और' (25), Hindi 'के रूप में' (26), 'ऐसा' (37), सम्पत्ति vs सम्पत् (42), sandheya vs glossary 7.6 (27), 'would have killed' (35).
